entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Futaba?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Can you hear me? Please, say something!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Please...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Could this be our fault? Is it because we[n]defeated her monstrous mother?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No, that was nothing more than a[n]cognitive being created in her mind.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Destroying it wouldn't cause memory loss[n]or put a physical burden on her...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What should we do?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, don't you know a doctor?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You do? Can you contact them?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: A house call is going to cost you,[n]you know.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: How much will it be?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...That was a joke.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So, um... how is her condition?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Her pulse, breathing, temperature, and[n]blood pressure are all normal. No ocular[n]abnormalities either.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I'm not sure why, but it seems this girl is[n]in some kind of light stupor.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Furthermore, she lacks muscle for her[n]age. I doubt she has much stamina either.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I see. The rebound from her awakening[n]was too strong...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There may have been too many abnormal[n]circumstances...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We simply cannot keep quiet about this.[n]We should let Boss know.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wouldn't he figure out our identities!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Still... we should tell him, shouldn't we?
Let's go get him.
Let's keep quiet.
Let's wait for now.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Mm, I think that would be best.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's not gonna solve anything.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What if nothing happens until it's too[n]late?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Letting him know is really the only option[n]we have.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I guess it can't be helped now...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Just keep the circumstances that led up[n]to this a secret, okay?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey, Futaba? Heyyy?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh dear...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Um... About Futaba...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hm? Why do you guys look so down?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Futaba-chan's condition...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What, this? It happens every so often.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: She must've used up all her energy.[n]It's like she ran out of batteries.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I think it happens 'cause she doesn't get[n]enough exercise.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: She stays like this for a few days whenever[n]this happens.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I'll make sure she gets plenty of rest.[n]Here, keep an eye on her. I'm gonna[n]go close the store.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's hard to describe how I feel right now...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, I'm feelin' pretty frustrated...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm glad she's okay... but what are we[n]gonna do about Medjed?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Ah...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: She's up!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Medjed...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Tired. Gonna sleep for a bit.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: She fell asleep again!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Futaba-chan!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: For a bit? How much is she planning[n]on sleeping?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We probably shouldn't wake her up[n]either...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What to do...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's too late for us to find another hacker...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All we can do is wait for her to wake up...
